scope: Draft schema and citing coverage; full staged gate also runs in safe-commit

grades.reason: AC4 asks for a genuinely separate article store with per-security/platform time lookup, not a news-table filter. The pinned table/shape record supplies the distinct key and both GSIs. This grades the issued storage design; an empty new store and a cached news ItemCount do not prove article coverage.

AC4 asks for precomputed axis/rank rows retrievable without scan-and-rank. The pinned schema has axis_date/ticker keys and axis-rank-index with rank_sort, enabling ordered Query and point retrieval. It does not prove an HTTP adapter exists or prohibit every caller from scanning.

AC4 asks for a scheduled producer, not a monitor, with the issued 30-day/0-100/top-10 semantics. The pinned worker instance, schedule source and producer controls meet that bar; zero article counts legitimately yield zero scores. This historical grade predates the migration residual in C-S49 and does not certify the currently deployed package, IAM or next scheduled run.

AC4 asks for a boxside Bloomberg price engine, not a Lambda, with the specified window/ranking semantics. The pinned host record, blp_client use and price functions meet that bar; 32 measured results out of 34 attempted are recorded rather than relabelled 34 successes. No new Bloomberg call was made by CVO.

AC4 asks for per-firm starred storage as a pure marker, without research/queue side effects. The pinned store keys by WATCHLIST#firm and writes/deletes one marker; offline tests corroborate shared-firm behavior and side-effect absence. This storage-level judgment does not certify a missing HTTP authentication boundary, pagination completeness or the uncovered test-harness mutation path in W7-S7.

AC4 and the inlined rd8 cell require the approved page shape and a read headless route render. At e6057f26 the persistent panel, three tabs and header Print location are present, but Trending/Breakout are mapped one-to-one to Chatter/Price instead of crossed controls; required /api/scoped/amgt adapters are not delivered; renderCheck.tsx renders fixture components and a PrintTriggerButtonReplica rather than the actual route/action. It cannot establish live ranking reads or renderer wiring. The StarredList iterates stored starred order, contrary to the report's producer-order filter claim; RankedChart is ticker-indexed and has no time-series implementation despite the stated automatic second-day behavior. Compile success cannot satisfy these clauses.

AC2 requires an independent clean no-emit staleness check. The issued root --noEmit invocation examines zero source files and misses the positive-control TS2322 error. The worker's -b/--force evidence diagnoses the instrument, but AC1 alone does not meet the independent control as issued. FAIL is the criterion/instrument verdict, not an accusation against the worker who correctly refused a false PASS. A corrected invocation and its cold/mutant controls require the issuer's existing-cell recut.
